Klasse Ingredient

java.lang.Object
org.schmuh.quisine.entity.Ingredient
@Entity public class Ingredient extends Object
Entity class representing an ingredient in the recipe system.

This class is mapped to the "Ingredient" table in the database, where each record represents a unique ingredient. The class uses JPA annotations to define the mapping between the entity and the database table.

  • id: The unique identifier for the ingredient (primary key). Generated automatically.
  • name: The name of the ingredient, which is required to be unique.
  • recipeIngredients: A set of RecipeIngredient objects representing the relationships between this ingredient and the recipes it is part of. This is a one-to-many relationship, where an ingredient can appear in multiple recipes.

Annotations:

  • Entity - Marks this class as a JPA entity that will be mapped to a database table.
  • Table - Specifies the name of the database table ("Ingredient") and the unique constraint on the "name" column to ensure that ingredient names are unique.
  • Id - Marks the primary key field of the entity.
  • GeneratedValue - Specifies the strategy for generating the ID value (auto-incremented).
  • Column - Defines how the fields map to columns in the database table.
  • OneToMany - Defines a one-to-many relationship between the Ingredient entity and the RecipeIngredient entity. The relationship is mapped by the "ingredient" field in the RecipeIngredient entity, with cascading operations and orphan removal enabled.
